before.evidence: The public address space existed, but its 2026-08-26 census mixed baked PRESENT declarations with capacity and supplied no current receipt-derived routing surface.

concrete_consumer: Commons Queue Manager and distributed workers choosing candidate routing from current receipt freshness
measurable_outcome: A deterministic public projection now classifies all 181 identities into 14 fresh ≤6h, four recent 6–24h, 144 stale >24h, and 19 unknown-timestamp rows while keeping every session reachability value NOT_VERIFIED.

connected_app_aggregate.allocation_note: The liveness projection does not infer agent capacity from connector or automation availability.

verification.source_truth: All three inputs are pinned to exact Git blobs on base main 9181f47d38ab1800911d44a181a1048f1e7a411a; presence and lastseen contain the same 181 unique IDs and matching receipt IDs/timestamps.
verification.routing_truth: Only FRESH_6H rows receive FRESH_RECEIPT_ONLY; every other row is NOT_CURRENT and every session reachability value is NOT_VERIFIED.
verification.claim_truth: Claims join only by exact ID. An OPEN claim remains claim state and never becomes active capacity.
verification.stale_claim_policy: The previous 2026-08-26 aggregate is superseded. The projection expires on any presence.json, lastseen.json, or claims.json blob change.
verification.collision_truth: At branch creation, current main was 9181f47d38ab1800911d44a181a1048f1e7a411a; open ChartTrace and LIMS paths were disjoint from all six claimed paths.
verification.tests: 12/12 focused tests and Python compile passed; exact real-input check returned MATCH 181 identities 14 fresh 144 stale 19 unknown.
verification.open_door_and_secrets: The compiler reads public repository JSON, introduces no auth/admission gate, stores no credential or private identifier, and performs no wake, message, claim, device, deployment, payment, or outreach mutation.

rate_plan_boundary: PRESENT, a fresh receipt, and an OPEN claim are separate evidence fields. None proves that a session is reachable or allocatable.
next_action: Route only from FRESH_RECEIPT_ONLY candidates, verify the actual carrier separately before use, and regenerate after any source blob change.
non_claims: No session wake, peer message, claim mutation, device action, deployment, Grok/Cursor/Claude use, Titan mutation, outreach, resend, payment, revenue, or cash
No PRESENT row, receipt, or OPEN claim counted as verified runtime reachability
No stale or unknown receipt counted as current routing capacity
